description: The user is brought to face what the row says (its `targets`): to a viewpoint the row names (its `where`: "... to VIEW_BACK, facing the screws"), to the side the row says ("... to the front of the cabinet, facing the door": `side`, `side_of`), or a spot the build finds where it is seen ("The user is teleported facing the screws"); what they face is never where they go. Written after a choice that ends its step, it happens as the step ends.
